title: The Mythical Brew: Restaurant Week menu from $175
summary: Choose a multi-course Restaurant Week meal from $175 per person, with clearly marked dairy-free choices in Cunupia.
description: For Trinidad & Tobago Restaurant Week, The Mythical Brew offers a $175 per-person package with a mocktail, main course and dessert, or a $275 package that adds a starter. The flat rates include taxes and charges. The published menu states that dairy-free options are clearly marked. Ask the venue which dishes qualify and confirm availability before booking. Available all day from September 25 through October 4, 2026.
